Simulated large losses of an excess of loss treaty

Source: R/reinsurance_pricing_data.R
xl_large_losses.Rd

The large losses of a simulated portfolio for the years 2015 to 2024, those of at least 500,000 in the money of their year: the experience of the examples of burning_cost and pareto_rating, with the premiums of xl_premium. In the money of 2025, at 4% claims inflation a year, they are Pareto with alpha 1.7 above 500,000, about 0.16 per million of on-level premium, with fewer in the recent years, whose losses are not all reported yet. The script that made it is in the package's source, under data-raw.

Usage

xl_large_losses

Format

A data frame with a row per loss and 3 columns:

claim

The claim's reference.

year

The year of the loss.

amount

The loss, in the money of its year.

Source

Simulated.

See also

xl_premium, burning_cost and pareto_rating.

Examples

table(xl_large_losses$year)
#> 
#> 2015 2016 2017 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 
#>    5    3    1    4    6    2    9    6    5    3
